text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy started: prompt-router-v2 -> prod (canary 8%). watch: https://dash.local/deploys/5120001234

sarah: seeing 95p latency jump on canary nodes, graphs look spiky. first seen ~5120001280.

mike_oncall: paging in, will grab logs and tcpdump.

incident-bot: Pager duty: mike_oncall assigned for incidents (sev3) — acknowledge with `ack`.

mike_oncall: ack — looking. tailing canary logs now. lots of 500s from /api/v1/prompt-route -> upstream timeout.

james_sre: I see kernel warnings on the new handler processes, maybe compatibility with qkv cache path.

sarah: quick sanity: rolling back to 0% would avoid customer impact. any chance we can flip flag?

james_sre: yes, recommend feature-gate kill: `ffctl set prompt_router_v2.enabled false --env prod`

mike_oncall: executing kill switch now.

mike_oncall: `ffctl set prompt_router_v2.enabled false --env prod` -> :white_check_mark: toggled at 5120001455

deploy-bot: Canary routing reverted to prompt-router-v1, traffic steady.

cs-ops: CS alert: two customers reported 502/timeout errors. tickets created: #INC-2345, #INC-2346. Notifying account teams.

sarah: monitoring metrics — error rate dropping back to baseline, latency normalizing.

james_sre: leaving notes: probable regression in new kernel selection under long prefix KV cache. need repro with local trace and run gated tests.

mike_oncall: adding links to runbook and logs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prompt-router and https://logs.local/g/5120001234

ana_oncall: (typo) -> ana_oncall: acknowledged handoff. I'll monitor the next 45m and coordinate postmortem.

ana_oncall: switching to ana_oncall: handing over at 5120001600, briefed on steps taken.

ana_oncall: monitoring looks stable. next steps: reproduce in staging with same kernel flags, add integration test around qkv path.

mike_oncall: I'll update runbook with quick rollback steps and ff name to avoid confusion.

cs-ops: emails sent to impacted customers, offering status update and ETA for postmortem.

sarah: marking this thread resolved for immediate action; create postmortem ticket and assign to eng-ml + eng-runtime.

james_sre: opening follow-up: PMT-987 (investigate kernel mismatch + test coverage).

mike_oncall: closing pager, handing final notes to ana_oncall. thanks all :thumbsup:
